title: HPC127-SHARP: exact rational slope and explicit polynomial bounds for the linear-classical tagged implementation

claims.statement: For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical HPC127-SHARP bit-code completion of proof.md executing COMPLETE HPC-127 P in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, rejected/discarded sources, failed/recycled pairing, failed merges, supplier/pool aborts, initialization and cleanup. Fully charged time is O(n^132*2^((4950737/3900250)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. A20=sum_(j=0..19)1/(4^j*(2j+1)),B20=2sum_(j=0..19)1/(3^(2j+1)*(2j+1)),R20=4/(3*41*4^20) give ln3<=A20+R20,ln2>=B20>0 and exact24727*B20-15601*(A20+R20)>0. Hence log2(3)<24727/15601 and beta=(31/100)*(24727/15601)+389/500=4950737/3900250. The unchanged PP=3^ell*2^m and table schedule imply T_P=O(n^6*2^(beta*sqrt n)). Explicit n^4 control completion,n^16 wire events and n^100 charged bit/event cost give total O(n^120)*(T_P+Qcap+H+1)+O(n^100)*D. Full D=O(n^30*2^(beta*sqrt n)),H=O(n^4*2^(beta*sqrt n)); all powers are at most130, conservatively132. Exact finite-overflow repair and eventual absence change no probability/source law; finite prefix costs change only outside constants. No QRAM or full exponential-pool scan per operation is assumed.

All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, rejected/discarded sources, failed/recycled pairing, failed merges, supplier/pool aborts, initialization and cleanup. Peak ordinary classical workspace is O(n) bits, exact growth index0. Count input/output, constant-many O(n)-bit operands/physical addresses/current-frame words, finite control and reusable bits/indices. All large source tables, loop/return/numerical/generator records, tags and original quantum free-list/descriptor fields are COUNTED basis qubits and streamed. Public parameters are computed with O(n) staging before bank initialization. Explicit n^4/n^16/n^100 degrees count operations/events, not materialized classical arrays. No huge ordinary stack, directory, epoch word, circuit or growing transcript is retained.

All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, rejected/discarded sources, failed/recycled pairing, failed merges, supplier/pool aborts, initialization and cleanup. Peak FULL allocated quantum workspace is O(n^30*2^((4950737/3900250)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. The complete fixed bank/pool are unchanged: U=C_0+2^(dl+m)+1,A=2^16*n^2,R=2^24*n^4*U,Wrow=2^16*n^2,H=2^20*n^2*U,B=2^56*n^8*U,e=(n+2)^20,D=B*(e+1)+(A+8)*e+A+2^20*n^4. Whole paired-prefix padding, inactive rows/owners, tags/raw headers/backup, every pointer/free-list descriptor, original coherent slot and source temporary count. The explicit rational log certificate gives PP=O(2^(beta*sqrt n)),beta=4950737/3900250>1269/1000,so U=O(n^2*2^(beta*sqrt n)),D=O(n^30*2^(beta*sqrt n)),H=O(n^4*2^(beta*sqrt n)). This is a maximum-address bound independent of lifetime, labels or successful-path occupancy. All epoch/free-slot operations are counted and indexed without a coherent bank oracle.

All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, rejected/discarded sources, failed/recycled pairing, failed merges, supplier/pool aborts, initialization and cleanup. All acquired DCP copies number O(n^3*2^((4950737/3900250)*sqrt n)), exact growth index1/2. Exactly one physical request executes each original request. Literal Qcap=4*n*C_0+K retains all supplier rejection, failed/recycled pairing, discarded merge, pool/batch abort and both recovery stages. C_0=O(n^2*3^ell*2^m),ell<=31r/100+1,m<=389r/500+1,r<=sqrt n+1, and proved log2(3)<24727/15601 imply the EXACT beta bound with only outside constants. Zero/tag/padding wires, descriptor/free-list work, source SWAPs and exact overflow repair are charged gates/storage rather than extra copies. No changed stopping or source-precision guard is introduced.

For every N>=2,s in Z/NZ,n=ceil(log2N), the SAME physical HPC127-SHARP bit-code completion of proof.md executing COMPLETE HPC-127 P in virtual.md recovers the WHOLE secret unconditionally with probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. All guarantees hold jointly on EVERY branch, including wrong labels, rejected/discarded sources, failed/recycled pairing, failed merges, supplier/pool aborts, initialization and cleanup. Guaranteed malformed fraction is epsilon(n)=0 under the exact independent-ideal-copy model. Decoding active epochs and the injective counted live-wire map preserves complete original CQ state, irreversible forgetting, quantum/source instruments, exact finite renumbering and full source/output law with arbitrary references. Extra helper outcomes are marginalized, never added to the inherited held-out-bit conditioning. No positive robustness, adaptive-supplier transfer or impossibility claim is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
